channel.title: RVA Figure Drawing
channel.description: Figure drawing sessions in Richmond, VA

item.title: Sat, Oct 17 · 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM — Figure Drawing Workshop [29]
item.description: Location: VMFA Studio School, 200 N Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: $95 (Member $80) | One-session workshop. Explore drawings of the human form by other artists, then work from a live model to create expressive portraits in charcoal and pencil. Instructor: Amy Smith. Prerequisite: basic drawing skills.

item.title: Wed, Oct 21 · 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM — Queer Life Drawing
item.description: Location: Gold Lion Community Cafe, 1012 Hull Street, Richmond, VA | Cost: $10 suggested donation | Queer Life Drawing at Gold Lion Community Cafe, hosted by RVA Thriving Artists. Figure drawing with live queer-identified models.

item.title: Wed, Oct 28 · 7:45 PM – 10:00 PM — Nude Figure Drawing: Halloween Edition!
item.description: Location: Unkindness Art, 2923 North Avenue, Richmond, VA 23222 | Cost: $10 | Long-pose nude figure drawing session with a single partially costumed model, Halloween themed. 18+ only, valid photo ID required. Tickets must be bought in advance, are nonrefundable, and there is no late entry after the 8:00 pm start. This is the last session of 2026 before the winter break.
